_comment: A runtime key name (process.env) is handed to an external module that returns it unchanged, and the service is looked up by what comes back. Tim's decision (2026-11-09): a runtime name string handed to and returned by code the pass can't see or doesn't follow is not read as a name of any key, as for strings that code makes itself. The lookup keeps nothing: both method definitions are removed and the bundle is not run. Canonical keys and literal key names returned by unseen code still reach their services (external_identity_key, external_returned_key_held). A runtime name carried in a structural key's key field is excluded by a separate decision (external_returned_structural_key).
